title: Sujith S - CTO, Product Owner, Zackriya Solutions | Meetily

children.text: CTO at Zackriya Solutions. Building Meetily, a privacy-first, open-source meeting assistant.

SEP 16, 2026
·
PRIVACY & SECURITY
Which AI Providers Train on Your Data? A 2026 Comparison

Does your AI provider train on what you paste in? We read 21 policies. What each one says, how long they keep it, and what changes with your plan.

AUG 25, 2026
·
PRIVACY & SECURITY
You Don't Need a Bot in the Room to Take Compliant Meeting Notes

A meeting bot adds a third party to a confidential conversation. Recording on your own device doesn't. What that changes under GDPR, and what it doesn't change about your duty to tell people.

JUL 24, 2026
·
MEETING RECORDING
How to Record a Meeting on Zoom, Meet & Teams (No Bot, Free)

Step-by-step: record any meeting on Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams for free - locally, with no bot joining the call. Transcription included.

MAR 3, 2026
·
PRODUCT UPDATE
Meetily v0.3.0: Import Audio Files, Retranscribe, and What's Coming Next

Meetily v0.3.0 introduces audio file import and retranscription for the open source meeting transcription app. Import recordings from any source, get local AI transcripts, and preview upcoming features like speaker diarization and dark mode.

FEB 27, 2026
·

10,000 GitHub Stars: Thank You for Believing in Privacy-First AI

Meetily just crossed 10,000 GitHub stars. A heartfelt thank you to the community that made this possible, and a look at what we're building next.

·
BUILD IN PUBLIC
10,000 GitHub Stars: Thank You for Believing in Privacy-First AI (Updated)

Meetily crossed 10,000 GitHub stars and is now at 31K+. A heartfelt thank you to the community that made this possible, and a look at what we are building next.

FEB 20, 2026
·
PRODUCT UPDATE
AI Meeting Summaries Without Sending Your Audio: Local or Bring-Your-Own-Key

Get AI meeting summaries without uploading your recordings to anyone. Meetily transcribes 100% locally, then summarizes with a local model (fully on-device) or your own API key (only transcript text leaves, audio never does). Privacy-first, pluggable, no meeting bots.

FEB 8, 2026
·

The Story Behind Meetily

How a frustrating client call led us to build a privacy-first meeting assistant. The real story of why we needed local storage, pluggable AI, and complete data control.

·

Our Quest for Meeting Summary Accuracy: What We Learned Building Meetily

Local AI models for meeting summaries have real trade-offs. Here's what we learned about hallucinations, missing action items, and why Meetily's pluggable architecture lets you choose between local and cloud models.

10 Best Free Meeting Recorder Apps 2026 (Transcribe, No Bot)
